newsitem.title: USA: Rio Hotel & Casino names David Hanlon COO.
newsitem.headline: Rio Hotel & Casino names David Hanlon COO.

text.p: Rio Hotel & Casino Inc said its board of directors had named David Hanlon as executive vice president and chief operating officer of the company.
It said the board had also appointed Hanlon as president and chief operating officer of its operating subsidiary, Rio Suite Hotel & Casino.
Hanlon was president and chief executive officer of International Game Technology, it added.
The company did not say who Hanlon would replace in those positions.
The company said it planned to develop a second hotel-casino next door to the Rio in Las Vegas, Nevada after the first quarter of 1997.
